description: A governance gate whose step name carries a PRODUCT token (OMN-18902). The coverage gate refuses because the pull request produced no integration test; its only distinctive substring is 'test'. Ranking the process family above the product family is what keeps this a missing-artifact refusal instead of a dispatched code fix, and this fixture is the proof that the ORDER decides it rather than the vocabulary.
evidence: measured 2026-09-20; one of the two corpus steps the plan's own prose vocabulary does not match

steps.name: Check for integration tests in PR
